# OpenBFME

OpenBFME is an independent community project reconstructing Battle for Middle-earth I and II in C++ and recreating Rise of the Witch-king in Godot. This site explains the projects, current alpha access, community, and dated code-reconstruction progress. It does not offer finished BFME I or II games.

## Official resources

https://openbfme.org/
https://github.com/Open-BFME/Open-BFME-1
https://github.com/Open-BFME/Open-BFME-2
https://github.com/Open-BFME/openbfme-godot
https://github.com/Open-BFME/openbfme-godot/releases

The percentages on the website are a 12 October 2026 snapshot of each game's code in C++, not overall game completion. Follow the source reports for current progress. The Godot alpha needs original game files.
